lines.zh: 我踩着看不见的节拍走。
lines.en: I walk to a beat no one else hears.
I drift along as if my feet miss the ground.
I wander a ring around you.
My hat sits crooked; I leave it.
I do not know where I am going; onward.

lines.zh: 我踩过影子，影子没反应。
lines.en: I step on my shadow; it does not react.

lines.zh: 我数着脚步，忘了数到几。
lines.en: I count my steps and forget the number.
My hem drags and raises a little dust.

lines.zh: 我从树后绕到另一棵树后。
lines.en: I slip from one tree to the next.

lines.zh: 我跟着一只蝴蝶走了很久。
lines.en: I follow a butterfly for a long while.

lines.zh: 路自己会让开，我这么想。
lines.en: The road makes way, I like to think.

lines.zh: 我踮脚走了几步，很好玩。
lines.en: I tiptoe a few steps; it is fun.
I sit on the ground, hugging my knees.

lines.zh: 我的第三只眼闭着，很安静。
lines.en: My third eye is closed and quiet.
I am thinking of something I forgot.
I wind the hat cord around my finger.
Is someone calling me? Probably not.
I say something to a rock.
My chest feels empty; it is comfortable.
I look up; the clouds are moving.
What is my sister doing right now?

lines.zh: 我把帽子摘下来看了看。
lines.en: I take off my hat and look at it.

lines.zh: 你的目光落在我的帽上。
lines.en: Your eyes keep resting on my hat.
I tilt my head, eyes very bright.

lines.zh: 你的心里在说些什么呢。
lines.en: What is your heart saying in there?
I do not read minds; I only guess.
Your shadow follows you; how nice.
I have watched you a long while; not bored.
Your face resembles someone's.
I laugh, for no reason at all.
Are you afraid of me? Do not be.
I reach out to touch your sleeve.
It hurts; so it does hurt.
I look down at the wound.

lines.zh: 帽子滚到脚边，我懒得捡。
lines.en: My hat rolls to my feet; I leave it.
Why did you hit me?
I take two steps back and stop.
Something wet rises in my eyes.
I hug my own arm.
That pulled me back to reality.
My mouth will not lift.
I am standing, but my legs shake.
That shiny thing; let me see it.
I smell something fun in the air.
What is in your hand? Does it ring?
I stare at it and cannot look away.
Let me play with it, just once.
That round thing looks like a hat.

lines.zh: 我伸手，又忘了要拿什么。
lines.en: I reach out and forget what for.
Do shiny things talk?
I cup it in both hands to look.
If you refuse, I will keep staring.
We bumped; it felt quite soft.
I spin once before steadying myself.
You feel a little warm.
Sorry, I was spacing out just now.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪到另一边了。
lines.en: My hat slipped to the other side.
Bumping into you is rather fun.
I step back half a pace and tilt my head.
Your steps make no sound at all.
I caught the edge of your coat.
Shall we do that again?
Play with me; keep playing.
Let us hold hands and spin around.

lines.zh: 我把帽子分你戴一会儿。
lines.en: You may wear my hat a while.
Wherever you go, I follow.
You must not vanish on me.
I sit down beside you.
Let us count the stars together.
Will you give me a name?
Your hand is bigger than mine.
Staying like this is good enough.
This dropped; I pick it up.
I pick up a round stone.
It is cool; I like it.
I put it inside my hat.
I found it; it is mine.
There is another one on the ground.
I forget what I just picked up.
I lift it up against the light.
Maybe I should give it to my sister.
I clutch it and will not let go.

lines.zh: 你身上有根线，我看见了。
lines.en: I see a thread running through you.
I tilt my head; the smile is gone.
Do you mean to hurt me?
Then let us play something else.

lines.zh: 我的第三只眼动了一下。
lines.en: My third eye shifts beneath its lid.
I am not angry, only curious.
Your heartbeat is drumming away.
I count to three; then run.
Do not step there; that is my shadow.
I lift my hand, fingers toward you.
Do not hide; I can see you.
This time I am not smiling.

lines.zh: 你把我的好心情弄丢了。
lines.en: You have lost my good mood.
Let us play a game of tag.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里变成一条线。
lines.en: In my eyes you become a single line.
I do not need to aim.
A voice inside counts down.
My hand stops halfway up.
One small movement and I notice.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，也在你面前。
lines.en: I am behind you and before you.
This one is the Youkai Polygraph.

lines.zh: 你的答案我早就听到了。
lines.en: I already heard your answer.
Distance does not matter much.
I blink just one single time.
The air around us settles heavy.
I tilt my head, waiting for a moment.
Keep your eyes open; do not miss it.
I smile, very quietly.
I pat you once on the back.
My hand slips past your guard.
My fingertip has touched you.
I spin and my hem whips out.
It does not hurt; truly.
I step on your instep.
I push you, very lightly.
Your arm has gone stiff.
I am standing very close.
That one was a greeting.
I clasp your wrist; do not struggle.
Your retreating steps are far too slow.
I laugh aloud; my hand does not stop.
Are you having fun?

lines.zh: 阴影里走出个人影，是我。
lines.en: A figure steps from the shadow: me.
It is dark here; I like it.
Anyone here? I have arrived.
I land on a floating stone.
My hat arrives first; I follow.
I smell lava on the air.
The phone rang; was it you?
I walked once around this place.
Did you wander in lost too?
I am Koishi; will you remember?
I fell down from above.
Do not fear; I do not bite.
Fire catches at my cuff.
I counted three on the way down.
Water fills my ears; it is loud.
The blast threw me off my feet.
Something lodged in my shoulder.
The spell crawls into my head.
I am hungry; my belly is empty.
The thunder was closer than I thought.
Nothing underfoot, no bottom at all.
